notes.title: Release date ! #1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone ! 

Thank you very much for those who added Equilibrium Realms to your wishlist, I sincerly hope you will enjoy the game.

I have decided to release ER on August 1st, to make sure I can add more content.

However, I may postpone this date, if I believe there's not enough content for players to be satisfied with their investment.

In the meantime, I'm going to work hard to make that happen ( a.k.a no sleep for a while ).

See ya !
